name: Mobile customer shell and protected admin entry
covers: admin login denial when credentials are incorrect
description: Checks the mobile customer shell and verifies the admin area remains protected while the redesigned layout works on a narrow screen.
steps: Open the portal at 375x667 and inspect the mobile header and bottom navigation.
Open Account and choose Admin studio.
Enter an incorrect admin password and submit.
Return to the customer screens and switch to night mode.
expected: The customer shell remains readable without horizontal overflow. The admin editor stays locked after an incorrect password and does not reveal editable plans or image controls.

name: Live Management Nexus plan catalogue
covers: active plans sourced from Management Nexus
single source of truth for plan price and speed
description: Verifies the customer portal renders the centrally managed active plan catalogue and uses the selected Management Nexus plan during checkout.
steps: Open Explore and inspect the active plans.
Compare the displayed plan name, price, speed and data allowance with the active Management Nexus plan catalogue.
Search for one active plan and sort by low-to-high price.
Select a plan and confirm the checkout review uses the same plan identifier and price.
expected: Only active Management Nexus plans appear. Plan search and sorting work, and the selected plan details remain consistent through checkout.

name: Connection request validation and safe failure handling
covers: visible management API failure and retry guidance
no false invoice or customer activation
description: Verifies a customer can prepare a real connection request and receives a clear retryable error if Management Nexus is temporarily unavailable.

body_json.error: K&B Management Nexus is temporarily unavailable. Your request was not submitted. Please try again.

steps: Select an active plan from Explore.
Enter a valid name, 10-digit mobile number, state, city, PIN code and installation address.
Continue without a demo OTP; review the mobile confirmation notice.
Choose Cash after installation, accept the terms and submit the connection request.
expected: The portal shows a clear retryable Management Nexus error. It does not show a successful booking, create an invoice, collect payment or claim that a customer account is active.

name: Admin campaign publishing while plans remain centrally managed
covers: plan catalogue read-only in Customer Studio
plan pricing managed in Management Nexus
description: Verifies portal administrators can publish campaign copy and images without creating a second source of plan pricing.
steps: Open Account and enter Admin Studio using the configured portal admin password.
Confirm the plan section directs administrators to Management Nexus for plan changes.
Edit the campaign headline and supporting message.
Upload a valid campaign image or add an HTTPS image URL.
Save and publish, then refresh the customer Home page.
expected: Campaign text and images remain published after refresh. Plan editing is not offered in Customer Studio; the customer catalogue remains sourced from Management Nexus.

name: Support complaint requires a registered mobile and real router photo
covers: live complaint proxy to Management Nexus
safe generic response for customer privacy
description: Verifies the complaint form sends the actual selected image and issue details to Management Nexus and blocks incomplete submissions.
steps: Open Support and choose Raise complaint.
Enter a registered 10-digit mobile number and describe the issue.
Try to submit without a photo and confirm submission is blocked.
Attach a JPG, PNG or WebP router/modem photo no larger than 2 MB and submit.
Review the generic server response and confirmation wording.
expected: The form blocks missing photos and invalid mobile numbers. With valid details it sends the real image bytes and issue to the Management Nexus proxy; the confirmation does not expose whether a phone number has an active account.
